descriptionChirho: Basic (Qal) sense of joyful vocalization — singing, shouting for joy, or exulting aloud in praise or celebration.
Qal sense of loud crying out or calling aloud, emphasizing urgent or distressed vocalization rather than joyful singing.
Intensive (Piel) sense of joyful singing or exultant shouting, expressing intensified gladness and jubilation.
Causative (Hifil) sense of causing or prompting others to sing, shout aloud, or exult with joy.
Passive (Pual) sense indicating that a song or joyful shout is being sung or performed.
Reflexive-intensive (Hitpael) sense of shouting or crying aloud, with emphasis on self-involved or demonstrative vocalization.
